pages.title: Welcome to the Busy Workspace
pages.content:
# Welcome 👋

This is a seeded QA workspace with realistic volume: 10 teammates, ~200 tasks across 4 project boards, long chat channels, and this mini wiki.

## Where to look

- **Projects** for the kanban boards
- **Channels** for chat history
- **Wiki** (you are here) for docs

> Generated by `scripts/demo-packs/make-pack.py`. Safe to delete and re-import.

pages.title: Coding Standards
pages.content:
# Coding Standards

1. Small PRs (< 300 lines) with a how-to-verify section.
2. Conventional commits: `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`.
3. No secrets in the repo — use `.env` + `.env.example`.
4. Green CI before requesting review.

pages.title: Onboarding Checklist
pages.content:
# Onboarding Checklist

- [ ] Accept the workspace invite
- [ ] Introduce yourself in #general
- [ ] Pick one `todo` task from Website Redesign
- [ ] Open your first draft PR
- [ ] Book a 15-min intro call with the team

pages.title: Study Guide
pages.content:
# Study Guide

Weekly rhythm: 3 focused blocks per day, one mock test per weekend. Track everything on the **Exam Prep** board.

## Resources

- Past papers folder (ask An for access)
- Formula sheets in the wiki children pages

pages.title: Exam Checklist
pages.content:
# Exam Checklist

- [ ] ID card + pens packed
- [ ] Calculator batteries checked
- [ ] Sleep before 23:00 the night before
- [ ] Arrive 30 minutes early
